description:
A goblin lives in Cheonuri, a village in the mountains that no one knows about. After his grandmother, his only family member, passes away, Seung-Hyo goes to the health center in the rural village of Cheonuri to console his empty heart. As soon as he arrives at Cheonuri, Seung-Hyo gets lost and meets Bon-Gi, a young man from the village, who unexpectedly helps her. However, Bon-Gi, who has a cold attitude despite helping her, eventually tells Seung-Hyo to leave the village as soon as possible.

 *"Do you believe that there are beings other than humans, Seung-Hyo?"* 

The secret hidden in the peaceful atmosphere of the village and the humble and kind village people is gradually revealed, and Bon-Gi reaches out to help Seung-Hyo, who is confused...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
